name: Hellhound
art_prompt: a lean muscular hellhound dog with charcoal-black fur, glowing orange cracks of ember running along its back and legs, a spiked iron collar, bared white fangs in a snarl, burning red eyes, pointed ears laid back, four legs, standing on all fours on the ground facing the viewer, its tail low behind it
motion: running in place on all fours with a fast bounding gallop, ears back, embers glowing
anim_negative: extra legs, five legs, extra heads, two tails, extra ears, wings
dead_hint: lying on its side on the ground, dead: eyes shut, tongue hanging out, its body stretched out sideways across the picture with its head on the left and its tail on the right, its four legs limp
back_hint: Its tail hangs low between its hind legs, the ember cracks visible along its back.
doc: Stage 3's runner: faster than anything on the sand, five times a goblin's health, packs of four on top of the regular roster. It closes the gap a slow build lives on.
